'''Lonkin''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] and a hero of [[Divac 7]]. In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], he was one of the best warriors of the [[Restored Empire]] faction, a splinter group that was formed after the death of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. He was stationed on [[RZ7-6113-23]], an asteroid, in which a [[RZ7-6113-23 base|facility]] was located. Lonkin was killed by [[Ennix Devian]] during a demonstration [[Vibro-lance/Legends|vibro-lance]] duel to impress [[Kir Kanos]], an [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]]. Kanos remarked that the death of a good soldier like him was a waste, and was annoyed.
